entry.title: Don’t Drop the Data: Engineering a Robust Soft Delete Pattern in EF Core
entry.summary: Soft delete is one of the most enduring patterns in enterprise systems: instead of permanently removing rows from your database, you mark them as deleted. This preserves history, enables audits, supports undo operations, and keeps your system safe from accidental “delete catastrophes.” In this deep dive, we implement a maintainable soft-delete architecture using EF Core, global query filters, and a clean, generic repository.
